display.purpose: The owner's name in the DRAWN BY cell only; uppercase. 1.9rem at or below 24rem.

headline.purpose: The one-sentence pitch at the top of the brief; balanced, max 15em (17em single column).

body-table.purpose: Step text in the standard-work table, ink-soft; bold term Barlow 600 0.9375rem in ink. 0.75rem on short desktops.

heading-rule.purpose: Section heads on a 1px rule and the table head; uppercase.

label.purpose: Top-left label in every title-block cell; uppercase, ink-soft.

caps.purpose: Roles and sheet number in the title block; uppercase.

exit.purpose: PLAY / OPEN / GITHUB with the outbound arrow; uppercase, underlined on inspection.

balloon.purpose: The number inside a view balloon.

numeral.purpose: Table step numbers in line white; 1.1rem on short desktops and stacked rows.

numeral-note.purpose: Note counters in the brief, nudged 0.12em to the body baseline.

zone.purpose: Border glyphs 1 to 8 and A to D, aria-hidden, ink-soft; 0.5rem at or below 68rem.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing curve: the develop and every 0.2s state transition.

motion.name: develop
motion.value: @keyframes develop { from { opacity: 0.4 } } on .sheet; 0.9s ease-out both; prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference only
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: the whole sheet comes up from 40% to full on load, as a cyanotype develops. Skipped under reduced motion.

motion.name: inspection
motion.purpose: Hover or focus-visible on a view link fills its balloon line white with on-white text and turns the exit underline line white. Nothing moves.

motion.name: button-hover
motion.purpose: The one white cell shifts to a slightly blued white.

breakpoints.name: short-desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Margin 10px, ring 14px, pad 16px; tighter row gaps, captions, table padding and title block (5.75rem/9rem columns, 5.75rem/3rem rows) so the title block stays in view at 1280x800.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: Ring 14px, zone glyphs 0.5rem. Field becomes one column: title block, brief, views. Title block moves to the top strip (6rem portrait, 1fr) with roles and contact rows; SHEET cell dropped; brief max 40rem.

breakpoints.name: stacked-views
breakpoints.purpose: Views stack 1, 2, 3; portrait frame max 15rem; table becomes five hairline-divided rows with numeral, term, text on one baseline.

focus.purpose: Every link, square-cornered. Selection inverts: line white background, on-white text.

portrait.value: filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.18) brightness(0.94); mix-blend-mode: screen; transform: scale(var(--portrait-zoom)); transform-origin: 60% 45%; cell background var(--sheet) with isolation: isolate
portrait.purpose: The portrait takes the cyanotype process: nothing prints darker than the blue, highlights stay paper white. --portrait-zoom (1.4) is a provisional crop for the 200px stand-in; set to 1 when the tight headshot lands.

components.css: :host{--sheet:#163F96;--line:#FFFFFF;--hair:rgb(255 255 255 / 0.55);--ink:#F5F8FF;--ink-2:#C7D5F5;--on-white:#163F96;--white-hover:#E2EAFF;--font:'Barlow',system-ui,sans-serif;--font-caps:'Barlow Semi Condensed','Barlow',system-ui,sans-serif;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)}.ds-sheet{position:relative;width:420px;background:var(--sheet);border:1.5px solid var(--line);padding:18px}.ds-zone{position:absolute;top:0;left:18px;right:18px;height:18px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(8,minmax(0,1fr));font-family:var(--font-caps);font-weight:600;font-size:.5625rem;line-height:1;color:var(--ink-2);user-select:none}.ds-zone span{display:grid;place-items:center}.ds-zone span+span{border-left:1px solid var(--line)}.ds-field{height:72px;border:1px solid var(--line)}

narrative.overview:
The page is one engineering drawing sheet, printed as a cyanotype. The Prussian blue runs edge to edge; everything drawn on it (the outer and inner borders, the zone strip, the view frames, the table rules, the title-block cells, every letter) is white line work, as if the sheet had been exposed from a single negative. There is no second colour on the sheet itself. Depth is never implied; the sheet is flat paper and the only things that sit "on" it are the pieces of evidence pinned into their frames.

Two kinds of lettering divide the sheet. Anything a drafter would letter by hand (the name in the title block, cell labels, zone glyphs, balloon numbers, exit labels, the ruled section heads, the table head, the note and step numerals) is Barlow Semi Condensed in capitals. Anything read as prose (the headline, the notes, view names and their one-liners, the table body, the button) is Barlow in sentence case. The condensed caps carry the drawing-sheet idiom; the prose face keeps it readable at a peer's pace.

Evidence keeps its own colour. Screenshots sit in their white frames at full colour, the only non-blue, non-white material on the page. The portrait is the one exception: it takes the cyanotype process (greyscale, screened onto the blue cell) so the drafter's face belongs to the sheet rather than being pinned to it. Motion is a single develop on load; nothing slides, scrolls in, or fades by section. The sheet refuses the centred avatar, bio, button and project-card stack, and it refuses the previous yellow-and-black shop floor entirely.
keyCharacteristics: A single Prussian blue ground with no gradient, texture, or tonal layering.
Every structural element is a white line: 1.5px outer border, 1px everything else, 55% white for secondary rules.
One solid white cell on the whole sheet: the Connect on LinkedIn button.
Two faces: Barlow Semi Condensed caps for drafting lettering, Barlow for prose.
True-colour evidence in white frames; the portrait alone takes the blue process.
Zoned border (1 to 8 across, A to D down) and a title block flush with the inner border.
One authored motion, the develop; one signature interaction, the inspection.

rules.name: The Blue or White Rule
rules.body: Every element the page draws is either the blue or a white. There is no accent, no second hue, no grey that is not a transparency of white. If a new surface needs emphasis, it gets more line, not more colour.

rules.name: The One White Cell Rule
rules.body: The sheet carries exactly one solid white fill at rest: the primary exit (Connect on LinkedIn). A second filled cell would make it a form, not a drawing. Balloons may fill white only while inspected.

rules.name: The Evidence Keeps Its Colour Rule
rules.body: Screenshots in view frames are shown in their own colour, untreated. The portrait alone takes the cyanotype process (greyscale, screen blend onto the blue). Never tint evidence blue and never show the portrait in colour.

rules.name: The Lettered or Read Rule
rules.body: Ask of every string: would a drafter letter it on the sheet, or is it read as prose? Lettered is Barlow Semi Condensed, uppercase, tracked. Read is Barlow, sentence case. No Semi Condensed sentence, no Barlow label.

rules.name: The Numeral Rule
rules.body: Every number that indexes something on the sheet (notes, balloons, table steps, zone glyphs) is Semi Condensed 700 or 600. Numbers inside prose stay in Barlow.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the sheet casts a shadow, at rest or in any state. Hover and focus change fill and underline, never elevation.

dos: **Do** draw every new container as a 1px line-white outline on the blue (1.5px only for the sheet's outer border); use hairline (55% white) for rules that subdivide an object.
**Do** decide lettered or read before setting any text: Barlow Semi Condensed uppercase and tracked if a drafter would letter it, Barlow sentence case if it is read.
**Do** keep evidence in true colour inside a 5px-inset white frame, and give every view a balloon number, a name, one line, and an exit word with the outbound arrow.
**Do** give every title-block cell a field label in the top-left corner, and keep the block flush with the inner border.
**Do** keep all motion to the develop on load and 0.2s fill or underline transitions with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
**Do** keep the focus ring 2px line white at 4px offset, square.
donts: **Don't** add a second colour, a gradient, glass, texture, or any grey that is not a transparency of white.
**Don't** add a second solid white fill at rest; the Connect on LinkedIn cell is the only one.
**Don't** cast shadows on anything, or lift, scale, or slide anything on hover.
**Don't** round corners; the balloon circle is the only curve.
**Don't** tint screenshots blue, or show the portrait in colour.
**Don't** set a sentence in Barlow Semi Condensed, set a label in Barlow, or introduce a third face or a system display face.
**Don't** fade or slide sections in on scroll, or stagger anything; the sheet develops once, whole.
**Don't** fall back to the centred avatar, bio, button, and project-card stack.
